bullets.text: Ran a supplied Python notebook to load provided public policy excerpt records for a supervised course project; edited simple filters and loops with step-by-step guidance.

Under supervision, executed and inspected supplied notebooks comparing rule-based and pretrained spaCy extraction on held-out annotated excerpts; checked span precision and recall and analyzed errors by entity type.
Executed and inspected supplied pandas and Matplotlib notebooks to clean supplied metadata tables using provided steps; plotted record counts and inspected missing-value summaries with guidance.
